==Description==
'''BETA v1.0''' was the first update to be officially released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 14th of June 2019. This update officially transitioned Tower Defense Simulator from Alpha Testing to BETA.

As with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was no official name for updates. As a result, the name '''BETA v1.0''' has been retroactively applied to this update.

This version encompassed two updates, the main BETA v1.0.0 update (released 14 June 2019) and the minor BETA v1.0.1 update (released 15 June 2019).

==Additions==
===Towers===
:All towers from Alpha are considered officially released from this update. However, only the [[Commander]] were exclusively added in this update, since they were not present in Alpha Testing.
*[[Scout]]
*[[Sniper]]
*[[Paintballer]]
*[[Demoman]]
*[[Soldier]]
*[[Farm]]
*[[Pyromancer]]
*[[Commander]]
*[[Minigunner]]

===Enemies===
:All enemies from Alpha are considered officially released from this update.
*[[Normal]]
*[[Speedy]]
*[[Slow]]
*[[Normal Boss|Boss1]]
*[[Hidden]]
*[[Mystery]]
*[[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]]
*[[Molten]]
*[[Slow Boss|Boss2]]
*[[Hidden Boss]]
*[[Shock|Lightning]]

===Maps===
:All maps from Alpha are officially considered released from this update. However, only [[Candy Cane Lane]] and [[Robloxia]] were exclusively added in this update, since they were not present in Alpha Testing.

*[[Sky Islands]]
*[[Island Chaos]]
*[[Castle]]
*[[Candy Cane Lane]]
*[[Robloxia]]
*[[Winter]]

===Miscellaneous===
*New [[Codes|code]]: FRIDAY
*Purchasing [[Currencies#Coins|Coins]] was added.

:All of the miscellaneous features from Alpha are considered officially released from this update.
*[[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy type
*[[Burn Immunity]]
*[[Firerate Buff]]

==Changes & Bugfixes==
:Due to the relative obscurity of the game, many of the tower changes and bugfixes went unnoticed.
